capabilities: Execute SQL SELECT queries over indexed vault data
Apply INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE writes with before/after preview
Render results as tables, charts, calendars, Markdown or JavaScript
Define reusable SQL views and custom JavaScript functions
Run SQL from the Obsidian CLI and inline vq{} values
extras: Natural-language queries send the schema, property names and request to a configured provider URL; documentation site and web sandbox are linked.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to query and modify notes, properties, tasks, tables, headings and links with SQL.

relations.evidence: Render query results as Chart.js visualizations
Render query results as a FullCalendar calendar
Results render in a sortable SlickGrid table.
Downloads the WASM for the sql.js version installed when this plugin was built.

summary: SQL query and write tool that runs SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE against indexed notes, properties, tasks, tables, headings and links.
